paligemma.meaning: Locate listed objects and return their boxes; objects may be referring expressions.
paligemma.inherited_evidence: configs/pre_freeze/grounding_interface_sources.v2.json: inherited_merged_evidence (processor, exact tokenizer and preprocessor checksums)
paligemma.limit: Google FAMILY syntax plus audited PaliGemma 1/model-ID decoder. Exact selected revision output conformance remains NOT_RUN. Empty decoder match is not native valid absence.

snapshot.hash_scope: Raw HTTP response bytes observed in G3; page content is mutable and may differ from G2 snapshot.

strict_subset: Both parsers require exact closed queried labels and preserve every detection in native order. Reject whole response on one malformed/unknown detection; no aliases, fuzzy labels, scale guessing, clamping, first/best box, dropped extras, repair or salvage.
source_reproduction: Fetch each URL as bytes, compare SHA256 and length, then inspect locator; never execute downloaded sources. Mutable page hash identifies only the accessed snapshot; no claim that future downloads are identical.
